name: openwiki
purpose: Generate or refresh source-linked wiki candidates through a separately configured OpenWiki runtime.
capabilities: scoped source-linked wiki candidate initialization or refresh
setup_steps: Install and pin openwiki@0.4.3 from an approved npm source
Use the project-local OpenWiki skill and openwiki mcp --host kiro definition
Disable telemetry and do not configure external connectors or a separate model provider
health_check: Resolve the reviewed command, then perform MCP initialize and tools/list without invoking a wiki generation tool
corrective_action: Install the approved OpenWiki package, verify the local Kiro MCP integration, and stop rather than configuring an external model provider.
permissions: Repository read access and openwiki candidate writes only; generated pages remain drafts.
